title: UI/UX DESIGN INTERN
qualification: Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Design, HCl, Computer Science or related field.
other_details: Duration: 3 MONTHS. Internship Type: UNPAID. Skills: Proficiency in Figma (or similar), Adobe XD, Photoshop, Illustrator. Understanding of UI design, UX principles, wireframing and prototyping. Basic knowledge of design systems and responsive design. Strong creativity, attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Eagerness to learn, take feedback and grow with the team. Responsibilities: Design clean, modern and user-friendly interfaces for web and mobile platforms. Create wireframes, prototypes and user flows to define intuitive user journeys. Collaborate with product, development and content teams. Conduct user research and usability testing to improve experience. Maintain design consistency across platforms and components. Contribute to the overall design thinking process and product improvement. Benefits: Real-world Industry Exposure, Mentorship from Industry Experts, Hands-on Learning of Modern Tools, Collaborative & Supportive Team, Certificate of Completion, Opportunity to learn, contribute and grow with us.
